items.title: Unemployment benefit revocation takes effect
items.quote: Sie nehmen am 01.09.2026 eine versicherungspflichtige Beschäftigung auf. Die Bewilligung von Arbeitslosengeld wird deshalb ab diesem Tag aufgehoben (§ 48 Abs. 1 SGB X).
items.computation: The letter states the benefit is revoked effective the calendar date given, 01.09.2026, which is when the person starts insured employment. This is a fixed calendar date, used as written.

items.title: Final ALG payment for August 2026
items.quote: Für den August 2026 zahlen wir Ihnen noch 1.318,20 €.
items.computation: The letter confirms a final unemployment-benefit payment of 1,318.20 € for August 2026 (money owed TO the recipient) but gives no specific payment date, so no exact due date can be determined.

items.title: Widerspruch against benefit revocation
items.quote: Er muss uns innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift erreichen (Agentur für Arbeit Musterbergen, Bahnhofstraße 12, 35037 Musterbergen).
items.computation: Bundesagentur für Arbeit is a social-law body (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X applies, not the tax-office Saturday/Sunday/holiday shift for delivery). Posting date = letter date 27.08.2026 (Thu); no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date is stated. Delivery is deemed on the 4th day after posting (posted after 1 Jan 2025): 27.08 + 4 days = 31.08.2026 (Mon); this day is not moved even though it happens to fall on a weekday anyway. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 26 SGB X, the delivery day itself is the event day for month-periods (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): one month after 31.08.2026 would numerically be '31.09', but September has only 30 days, so the period ends on the last day of that month, 30.09.2026 (Wed). This is not a Saturday, Sunday or NRW public holiday, so no further shift applies (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X).
